# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Environments

> 15 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta under Environments. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Environments

- [Acknowledge Work](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/ack.md): Note: these endpoints are called automatically by the pre-built environment worker provided in the SDKs and CLI, for orchestrating sessions with self-hosted sandbox environments.
- [Archive Environment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/archive.md): Archive an environment by ID. Archived environments cannot be used to create new sessions.
- [Create Environment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/create.md): Create a new environment with the specified configuration.
- [Delete Environment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/delete.md): Delete an environment by ID. Returns a confirmation of the deletion.
- [Get Environment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/retrieve.md): Retrieve a specific environment by ID.
- [Get Queue Statistics](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/stats.md): Get statistics about the work queue for an environment.
- [Get Work Item](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/retrieve.md): Note: these endpoints are called automatically by the pre-built environment worker provided in the SDKs and CLI, for orchestrating sessions with self-hosted sandbox environments.
- [List Environments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/list.md): Include archived environments in the response
- [List Work Items](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/list.md): Note: these endpoints are called automatically by the pre-built environment worker provided in the SDKs and CLI, for orchestrating sessions with self-hosted sandbox environments.
- [Poll for Work](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/poll.md): Note: these endpoints are called automatically by the pre-built environment worker provided in the SDKs and CLI, for orchestrating sessions with self-hosted sandbox environments.
- [Record Heartbeat](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/heartbeat.md): Note: these endpoints are called automatically by the pre-built environment worker provided in the SDKs and CLI, for orchestrating sessions with self-hosted sandbox environments.
- [Stop Work](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/stop.md): Note: these endpoints are called automatically by the pre-built environment worker provided in the SDKs and CLI, for orchestrating sessions with self-hosted sandbox environments.
- [Update Environment](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/update.md): Update an existing environment's configuration.
- [Update Work Item](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work/update.md): Metadata patch. Set a key to a string to upsert it, or to null to delete it.
- [Work](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments/work.md): Metadata patch. Set a key to a string to upsert it, or to null to delete it.
